description: Get the walls of a level: start and end in metres, length, stored and resolved height, thickness, and their doors and windows. wallFaceChains gives base-chain provenance for geometric faces a (left of start → end) and b (right): ref (authored face slot), legacy (inline spec), or default (declared fallback ref). These are not final rendered finishes: room intent, face paint regions, exterior assembly cladding and reference availability can change appearance. A chosen white or default-matching ref is legitimate; fallback alone is not a defect or a requirement to paint.

levelId.description: The level, by an id list_levels returned; an id made up from a name ("level_1", "level_ground") does not exist. Default: the floor the person is viewing, else the lowest floor.

name: get_walls
title: Get walls
